title: chipledger: an accounting identity for AI-accelerator performance growth, 2012–2026
description: Is Huang's Law Moore's Law? chipledger is a sourced dataset of data-centre AI accelerators (2012–2026) and an exact per-chip accounting identity that splits the growth of headline throughput into transistor density (Moore's law proper), total die area including multi-die packaging, clock, architectural specialization at fixed precision and the gain from narrower arithmetic, with a source for every value and an uncertainty for every share. Pre-registered design. Independent personal research; public data only; does not represent the views of any employer or institution. Code: MIT. Data: CC-BY-4.0.
